node: Firm power, nuclear restarts, SMRs, advanced reactors, and nuclear fuel
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the nuclear firm-power chokepoint beyond the seed list. The strongest additions are not just reactor-concept equities; they map to five execution layers: newly public advanced reactor/fuel platform exposure, operating nuclear generation with hyperscaler PPAs, nuclear-grade components, and domestic uranium supply. Key separation criterion: favor companies with operating assets, public counterparties, DOE/NRC milestones, fuel-chain assets, or qualified component positions over pure narrative exposure.
